# Placeholder image allowlist for .github/scripts/check-fleet-attestations.sh
#
# Images declared in openbank-infra/gitops/ that are deliberate FIRST-REGISTRATION
# placeholders: the tag has never been built or pushed, so the image is absent from ECR
# entirely. These cannot be admitted to the cluster at all (Kyverno blocks even ArgoCD's
# dry-run diff for a nonexistent tag, so the app sits at sync status Unknown rather than
# ImagePullBackOff), and they are NOT an attestation regression — a nonexistent image
# cannot be an unattested one.
#
# This allowlist exists so the gate can reach GREEN and therefore stay credible. A check
# that is permanently red because of a known placeholder is a check people learn to ignore.
#
# STRICT SCOPE — this file may ONLY list images absent from the registry. It can never
# suppress an UNATTESTED image (present in ECR, no attestation); that class is always fatal
# and has no allowlist, because that is precisely the class that caused the 2026-07-12
# admission failures.
#
# Remove an entry the moment the service is genuinely built + pushed. One image ref per
# line, exact match, full registry path.

# finrep-service: first ArgoCD registration (ADR-0097); never built via build-push-service.sh.
# See the header note in openbank-infra/gitops/components/finrep/finrep-service.yaml.
265175468565.dkr.ecr.eu-north-1.amazonaws.com/openbank-finrep-service:sandbox-init

# vop-service: first registration from #1195 (ADR-0095 Verification of Payee). Same shape as
# finrep — module and gitops manifest merged, but no Dockerfile, no ECR repo, absent from
# auto-deploy's ALL_SERVICES, so the tag has never been built. Tracked in #1205 alongside the
# guard that should have refused to merge a released component in this state.
265175468565.dkr.ecr.eu-north-1.amazonaws.com/openbank-vop-service:sandbox-placeholder

# delegation-service: first ArgoCD registration (ADR-0232, #2992). The module, the OPA bundle
# and the enforcement projections all merged before anything could deploy it — it was absent
# from auto-deploy's ALL_SERVICES (added in the same PR as this line), so the tag has never
# been built. Unlike finrep/vop this one has a Dockerfile and an ALL_SERVICES entry from day
# one, so the fix is a single dispatched build rather than more missing pieces:
#   gh workflow run auto-deploy.yml -f services=openbank-delegation-service
# DELETE THIS ENTRY once that build lands and the auto-deploy gitops PR rewrites the pin.
265175468565.dkr.ecr.eu-north-1.amazonaws.com/openbank-delegation-service:sandbox-900c64bbf

# case-coordinator-agent: first ArgoCD registration (ADR-0244 Phase 4, #4187). Same shape as
# delegation-service above — the module, its Dockerfile and its auto-deploy ALL_SERVICES entry
# all land in this PR, so the tag has never been built and the image is absent from ECR.
# The ECR REPOSITORY does not exist either (verified: DescribeRepositories -> RepositoryNotFound),
# so the first build both creates the repo and pushes the image; that works only while the CI
# role still holds ecr:CreateRepository. Dropping that grant (#3661) before this service's first
# build would break it — sequence the two.
#   gh workflow run auto-deploy.yml -f services=openbank-case-coordinator-agent
# DELETE THIS ENTRY once that build lands and the auto-deploy gitops PR rewrites the pin.
265175468565.dkr.ecr.eu-north-1.amazonaws.com/openbank-case-coordinator-agent:sandbox-4405a74fa

# referral-service: first sandbox registration. The service existed before its GitOps workload,
# so auto-deploy could not build it and this source tag is absent from ECR. The Deployment is
# deliberately held at replicas=0; scheduled/manual reconcile builds, signs and attests the image
# through the normal contract gate, then rewrites this pin in a reviewed GitOps PR.
# DELETE THIS ENTRY as part of that image-pin PR, before the separate replicas=1 activation.
265175468565.dkr.ecr.eu-north-1.amazonaws.com/openbank-referral-service:sandbox-d92d20f5
